blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: client–server — Managed service provided by server to requesting clients.
centralisation — Services controlled from a smaller set of authorities.

blocks.title: Verify authentic file
blocks.text: A P2P distribution model can share upload load among peers, reducing demand on one central server. Clients must verify file authenticity with trusted signatures/hashes; peers may be untrusted or offline.
